text:
Ethanol can be made by the fermentation of aqueous glucose and by the catalytic addition of
steam to ethene.
What are two advantages of making ethanol by the catalytic addition of steam to ethene rather
than by the fermentation of aqueous glucose?
A
faster reaction and renewable raw materials
B
purer product and faster reaction
C
renewable raw materials and continuous process
D
uses more energy and forms a purer product

options.label: A
options.text: faster reaction and renewable raw materials

options.label: C
options.text: renewable raw materials and continuous process

options.label: D
options.text: uses more energy and forms a purer product
